question: Which vision-language model, embedding model, and vector database does Part 5 recommend for automated-vehicle traffic-control-device recognition?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD does not recommend any vision-language model, embedding model, or vector database. Part 5 explicitly does not address specific technologies of that kind — it provides only general considerations for how traffic control devices (signs, markings, signals) can be designed and applied to better accommodate driving automation systems, and it states that the Manual does not standardize digital infrastructure. The evidence is insufficient to identify any specific software product or model because no such recommendation exists in the MUTCD. Visual evidence: [Image 4] Table 5A-1 defines the SAE automation levels (Level 0–5) and their categories (ADAS vs. ADS), with no mention of any software models or databases. [Image 5] Page 800 shows Part 5's scope (Sections 5A.01–5A.03), which describes AV sensors (cameras, radar, LiDAR, ultrasonic, infrared) but names no recognition models or databases. [Image 8] Page 803 (Chapter 5B) gives guidance on signs, markings, and signals for driving automation systems — e.g., sign uniformity and LED refresh rates — again without naming any specific technology products. Citations: - Section 5A.01 Support §1 (p.759) - Section 5A.04 Support §1 (p.761) - Table 5A-1 (p.760) - Page 800 - Page 803
